Preserve authority links, interpreted predicates, derivations including shared derivations, and separate actual execution provenance in existing ticket/evidence carriers; neither per-test tickets nor duplicate ledgers follow. An acceptance predicate also requires an applicable supported entry/state and an obligation under the governing operating/threat model.
